title: The Ashen Heart
summary: Ha-Jun and Min-Jae travel to the volcanic depths beneath Bukhansan mountain. Navigating boiling sulfur vents and magma lakes, Ha-Jun discovers the third basic relic: The Ashen Heart.

panels.shot: bukhansan mountain at morning wide shot
panels.action: The jagged granite peaks of Bukhansan National Park shrouded in mysterious crimson morning mist.
panels.prose_en: The jagged granite peaks of Bukhansan National Park shrouded in mysterious crimson morning mist.
panels.prose_hi: Bukanson national park ki dantedar granite chotiyan rahasyamay lal subah ki dhundh mein doobi hui han.

panels.action: Behind a roaring frozen waterfall, an ancient cavern mouth glows with unnatural volcanic orange heat.
panels.prose_en: Behind a roaring frozen waterfall, an ancient cavern mouth glows with unnatural volcanic orange heat.
panels.prose_hi: Garjte hue jame hue jharne ke pichhe, ek prachin gufa ka muh aprakritik jwalamukhiya narangi garmi se chamakta hai.

panels.action: Min-Jae holds a specialized mana-radiation detector; the needle pegs into the red zone.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Is cave ke niche magma ka flow normal nahi hai... Yeh pure Demonic Hellfire source hai!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae holds a specialized mana-radiation detector; the needle pegs into the red zone.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ke paas ek vishesh mana-vikiran detector hai; sui lal kshetra mein ragon mein utarne lagti hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun tightens his tactical gloves, his white bone gauntlet concealed under a dark thermal sleeve.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tum yahan entrance par hi ruko, Min-Jae. Niche ka temperature insaan ke liye fatal hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun tightens his tactical gloves, his white bone gauntlet concealed under a dark thermal sleeve.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apne samrik dastaane kas liye, uski safed haddi ka kavach ek gahre thermal aasteen ke neeche chhipa hua tha.

panels.action: Min-Jae hands over an aerosol cryo-canister: 'Ise emergency mein use karna.'

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Sambhal kar, Ha-Jun. Bhai ke baad tum hi mere sabse acche dost ho.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae hands over an aerosol cryo-canister: 'Ise emergency mein use karna.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je ek aerosol crio-canister saunpte han: 'ise aapatkalin sthiti mein upyog karna.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with quiet gratitude: 'Main zinda wapas aaunga, promise.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles with quiet gratitude: 'Main zinda wapas aaunga, promise.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shant kritagyata ke saath muskurate han: 'main jinda wapas aaunga, vaada karta hun.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun descends down a steep obsidian ramp; walls of glowing red magma veins illuminate the dark.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun descends down a steep obsidian ramp; walls of glowing red magma veins illuminate the dark.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek khadi obsidian ramp se neeche utarta hai; chamakti lal magma shiraon ki deewaren andhere ko roshan karti han.

panels.action: Kuro glides effortlessly through the thermal updrafts, obsidian feathers shimmering with purple embers.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Aah... Yeh garmi mujhe home realm ki yaad dilati hai!

panels.prose_en: Kuro glides effortlessly through the thermal updrafts, obsidian feathers shimmering with purple embers.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro thermal updraft ke madhyam se sahajta se udta hai, obsidian pankh baingani angaron se jhilmilate han.

panels.action: A vast underground cavern opens up: a boiling lake of bubbling crimson-orange magma stretching 300 meters across.
panels.prose_en: A vast underground cavern opens up: a boiling lake of bubbling crimson-orange magma stretching 300 meters across.
panels.prose_hi: Ek vishal bhumigat gufa khulti hai: 300 meter tak faili bulbuledar lal-naarangi magma ki ubalti hui jhil.

panels.shot: steep stone pillars sticking out of lava
panels.action: Jagged black basalt stepping stones rise out of the boiling lava, forming a precarious path to the center.
panels.prose_en: Jagged black basalt stepping stones rise out of the boiling lava, forming a precarious path to the center.
panels.prose_hi: Daantedar kale basalt patthar ubalte lava se bahar nikalte han, jo kendra ke liye ek anishchit rasta banate han.

panels.action: Ha-Jun stands on the basalt ledge; the ambient air is over 60 degrees Celsius, air shimmering with heat mirages.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Har saans lene par gale mein aag lag rahi hai... Lekin mujhe aage badhna hoga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands on the basalt ledge; the ambient air is over 60 degrees Celsius, air shimmering with heat mirages.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun basalt kagaar par khada hai; pariveshi hawa 60 degree celsius se adhik hai, hawa garmi ki mrigtrishna se jhilmila rahi hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps from pillar to pillar with nimble athletic balance, lava bubbling mere feet below.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leaps from pillar to pillar with nimble athletic balance, lava bubbling mere feet below.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun furtile athletic santulan ke saath ek khambhe se dusre khambhe tak chhalang lagata hai, keval kuch feet neeche lava ubal raha hai.

panels.shot: magma salamander fiend erupting from lava
panels.action: A 10-foot armored Magma Salamander with molten rock scales erupts from the boiling lake, snapping jaws.
panels.prose_en: A 10-foot armored Magma Salamander with molten rock scales erupts from the boiling lake, snapping jaws.
panels.prose_hi: Pighali hui chattanon ke saath 10 foot ka bakhtarband magma sailamander ubalti hui jheel se nikalta hai, jisse jabde toot jaate han.

panels.shot: salamander spitting jet of liquid flame
panels.action: The beast spews a torrent of 1,000-degree liquid hellfire straight toward Ha-Jun's landing spot.
panels.prose_en: The beast spews a torrent of 1,000-degree liquid hellfire straight toward Ha-Jun's landing spot.
panels.prose_hi: Janvar sidhe Ha-Jun ke landing sthal ki or 1,000 degree taral narkankaal ki dhara ugalta hai.

panels.action: Ha-Jun raises his left arm; the white bone gauntlet interlocks, forming a solid shield that deflects the molten spray.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises his left arm; the white bone gauntlet interlocks, forming a solid shield that deflects the molten spray.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna bayan haath uthata hai; safed haddi ka gauntlet aapas mein jud jata hai, jisse ek thos dhal ban jaati hai jo pighle hue spray ko vikshepit kar deti hai.

panels.action: Kuro cackles: 'Dekha?! Bone of the Forgotten molten rock ko bhi block karti hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ab ise khatam karo! Sanguine Fang!

panels.prose_en: Kuro cackles: 'Dekha?! Bone of the Forgotten molten rock ko bhi block karti hai!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro chillata hai: 'dekha?! bhuli hui pighli hui chattan ki haddi bhi block karti hai!'.

panels.action: Ha-Jun draws his blood katana; the intense heat causes the crimson blade to hiss with boiling steam.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun draws his blood katana; the intense heat causes the crimson blade to hiss with boiling steam.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apna khoon katana khinchta hai; tivra garmi ke karan lal rang ka blade ubalti bhaap se fufkarne lagta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun launching off pillar at salamander
panels.action: Ha-Jun vaults forward, slicing cleanly through the beast's armored neck in a diagonal aerial stroke.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun vaults forward, slicing cleanly through the beast's armored neck in a diagonal aerial stroke.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aage badhta hai, ek vikarna hawai stroke mein janwar ki bakhtarband gardan ko saf-saf kaatata hai.

panels.action: The headless salamander splashes back into the boiling magma, dissolving into liquid rock.
panels.prose_en: The headless salamander splashes back into the boiling magma, dissolving into liquid rock.
panels.prose_hi: Bina sir wala sailamander ubalte hue magma mein wapas foot jata hai aur taral chattan mein ghul jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing on central obsidian altar
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands firmly on a circular black volcanic glass platform in the dead center of the lake.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands firmly on a circular black volcanic glass platform in the dead center of the lake.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun jheel ke mrit kendra mein ek golakar kale jwalamukhiya kaanch ke manch par majbuti se utarta hai.

panels.shot: the ashen heart suspended in midair
panels.action: Floating above an obsidian basin: a charred, petrified volcanic heart the size of a human skull, beating with violet flame.
panels.prose_en: Floating above an obsidian basin: a charred, petrified volcanic heart the size of a human skull, beating with violet flame.
panels.prose_hi: Ek obsidian basin ke upar tairta hua: manav khopdi ke aakaar ka ek jala hua, pathreela jwalamukhiya hridy, jo baingani lau se dhadak raha hai.

panels.action: From the cracks in the volcanic heart, wisps of violet-and-crimson demonic flame hiss into the sulfurous air.
panels.prose_en: From the cracks in the volcanic heart, wisps of violet-and-crimson demonic flame hiss into the sulfurous air.
panels.prose_hi: Jwalamukhiy hriday ki daraaron se, baingani aur lal rang ki shaitani demonic lau ki kiranen gandhak bhari hawa mein fusfusati han.

panels.action: Kuro's eyes burn with solemn reverence: 'The Ashen Heart. First Sovereign ke wrath ka pyre.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Yeh relic tumhare andar Hellfire control ko unleash karega.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's eyes burn with solemn reverence: 'The Ashen Heart. First Sovereign ke wrath ka pyre.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki aankhen gambhir shraddha se jalti han: 'd ation hart. pehle prabhu ke krodh ki chita.'

panels.shot: ha-jun staring at beating flame heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun can hear the rhythmic thumping of the heart synchronizing with his own chest.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Meri heartbeat... iske saath align ho rahi hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun can hear the rhythmic thumping of the heart synchronizing with his own chest.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apni chhati ke saath taal milate hue dil ki dhadkan ko sun sakta hai.

panels.action: Kuro warns him strictly: 'Agar tumhara will kamzor pada, toh yeh aag tumhare organs ko raakh bana degi.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ise absorb karne ke liye tumhe apne dono relics ko synchronize karna hoga!

panels.prose_en: Kuro warns him strictly: 'Agar tumhara will kamzor pada, toh yeh aag tumhare organs ko raakh bana degi.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne use sakhti se chetavani di: 'agar tumhara kaam kharab hoga, to yeh aag tumhare angon ko rakh degi.'

panels.action: Ha-Jun extends his left bone gauntlet and his right ringed hand, forming a dual-relic containment field.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun extends his left bone gauntlet and his right ringed hand, forming a dual-relic containment field.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apni bayin haddi ka kavach aur dahina ring wala haath badhaya hai, jisse ek dohre-avshesh niyantran kshetra ka nirman hota hai.

panels.action: A double-helix of violet mana and crimson blood spirals out from his palms, wrapping around the burning heart.
panels.prose_en: A double-helix of violet mana and crimson blood spirals out from his palms, wrapping around the burning heart.
panels.prose_hi: Uski hatheliyon se baingani maina aur lal rang ke khoon ka ek duble-helix nikalta hai, jo jalte hue hriday ke charon or lipatne lagta hai.

panels.shot: the ashen heart vibrating with violent fury
panels.action: The charred heart shrieks like an awakening furnace, unleashing a deafening blast of violet hellfire.
panels.prose_en: The charred heart shrieks like an awakening furnace, unleashing a deafening blast of violet hellfire.
panels.prose_hi: Jala hua dil ek jagrit bhatti ki tarah chillata hai, jisse baingani narkankaal ka bahra kar dene wala visfot hota hai.

panels.shot: flames engulfing ha-jun in a pillar of fire
panels.action: A 50-foot tornado of violet-crimson hellfire erupts skyward, completely swallowing Ha-Jun's silhouette.
panels.prose_en: A 50-foot tornado of violet-crimson hellfire erupts skyward, completely swallowing Ha-Jun's silhouette.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni-lal rang ki narkankaal ki aag ka 50 foot ka bavandar aasman ki or badhta hai, jo Ha-Jun ki chhaya ko puri tarah se nigal jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes burning through the firestorm
panels.action: Inside the raging inferno, Ha-Jun's eyes ignite with blinding white-violet power as he refuses to yield.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN TUJHE CONTROL KAR KE RAHUNGA... ASHEN HEART!!

panels.prose_en: Inside the raging inferno, Ha-Jun's eyes ignite with blinding white-violet power as he refuses to yield.
panels.prose_hi: Bhishan narak ke ander, Ha-Jun ki aankhen chakachaundh kar dene wali safed-bangni shakti se prajvalit ho uthti hain kyonki wah jhukne se inkar kar deta hai.
